prerequisite: The drawing has sample line groups but every SampleLineLabelGroup entity was deleted (a common after-effect of ERASE on the sample line family before export; see the c3d-sample-lines-traps note). Compare with a healthy drawing using entity_stats: in a healthy drawing the SampleLineLabelGroup count == SampleLineGroup count
fixture_requirements: At least one sample line group with a known number of sample lines
The target sample line label style exists (LabelStyles.SampleLineLabelStyles.LabelStyles)
Control: a similar drawing with intact labels, to confirm the label group count should equal the sample line group count
assertions: In-memory change only: results must be kept with an explicit save_dwg (and apply:true on the host drawing throws eFilerError; only save-as to a sibling file and swap works, see the accoreconsole-limits note)

API fact: SampleLine has no LabelStyleId, only the StyleId controlling the line's appearance; labels are separate entities attached to the group, created one per group with SampleLineLabelGroup.Create(groupId, labelStyleId). 'Assign a label style per line' does not exist -- do not try again
Built-in acceptance that blocks: label_groups_after == groups_total and sub_entities_after == sample_lines_total; if either fails, throw and do not Commit (prevents a quiet success)
Idempotent: skip_existing defaults to true; groups that already have labels are skipped and reruns do not stack a second layer of labels
skip_existing:false creates another label group for groups that already have labels -- use only when deliberately re-laying with a new style
dry_run:true only takes inventory; the receipt has action=would_create and the drawing is untouched
An unknown style name throws and names it (case-sensitive; @C3DF-AlignmentStation and C3DF-RouteNameWithStation are two different styles)
With alignment given, only that alignment's groups are repaired; an alignment name absent from the drawing throws and names it
Real run 2026-08-27: 11 groups / 215 lines all created; plot_pdf spot check of the Z5 stretch shows Z5#-K0+050 ... Z5#-K0+350, one label every 50 m
